structured_output.analysis: The best grid, iso_3.15, measures KL=0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 average bits. The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits, which leaves only about 0.2M bits spare. That is too little for even one int3→int4 upgrade on a 3.1M-parameter MLP layer, which costs about 3.1M bits. The knapsack already chose the lowest-KL method at each bit width for the layers where loss is concentrated. For example, up_proj in layer 27 uses gptq_int3 (0.00572) rather than rht_gptq_int3 (0.00774). Up_proj in layer 3 uses rht_gptq_int3 (0.00642) rather than gptq_int3 (0.00706). So swapping methods at the same width gains nothing. That leaves two levers. (1) Options that do not change bits: GPTQ act_order=true, which is untested here. (2) Freeing bits by raising rht_gptq_int3 to weight.group_size=256, which roughly halves its scale overhead. Those bits then pay for int4 upgrades of the MLP layers with the largest measured int3→int4 KL drop. Those layers are layer 27 up_proj and gate_proj, and up_proj in layers 1, 2 and 3; each would gain about 0.0035–0.0040 single-layer KL. The bit cost of group_size=256 is my estimate, not a measured figure, so proposal C may be refused as over budget.

proposals.name: iso315_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same cells as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]); only act_order=true is set on all GPTQ variants. This costs no stored bits. The loss is concentrated in GPTQ int2/int3 MLP layers, e.g. layer 14 down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] and layer 27 up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded].

proposals.name: iso315_g256int3_mlp_up4
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 frees scale bits to pay for five int4 upgrades. Their single-layer KL goes from int3 to int4 as follows. Layer 27 up_proj: 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to 0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc]. Layer 27 gate_proj: 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67] to 0.00153 [Ef428ac081334]. Layer 3 up_proj: 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] to 0.00238 [Ef4ee8cb4969e]. Layer 2 up_proj: 0.00642 [E9baa10763ebe] to 0.00237 [Ef3d9c7b4502c]. Layer 1 up_proj: 0.00611 [E0564bc6ad1eb] to 0.00227 [E779bc065b72e]. Base: [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: iso315_g256int3_mlp_up4_actorder
proposals.rationale: Combines the two ideas: weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 pays for int4 upgrades of the layers with the largest measured int3→int4 KL drops, and act_order=true is set on all GPTQ variants at no bit cost. Layer 27 up_proj goes from 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to 0.00217 [Efea8c18d2abc]. Layer 27 gate_proj goes from 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67] to 0.00153 [Ef428ac081334]. Layer 3 up_proj goes from 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] to 0.00238 [Ef4ee8cb4969e]. Base KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].
